business_summary: Milkyway Intelligent Supply Chain Service GroupCo., Ltd. provides chemical supply chain solutions worldwide. Its services include import and export cargo solicitation, booking, consignment, warehousing, packaging, loading/unloading, transshipment, distribution, handling of declaration and inspection, cargo insurance, international multimodal transport, third-party logistics, and contract logistics; leasing and transportation services for domestic and international trade through various sizes of liquid bulk carriers and tank containers; transportation modes for oil and gas, petrochemical, renewable energy, nuclear power, infrastructure, engineering construction, and mining and metallurgy industries; and engineering logistics, and self-built tank container yard networks. The company also provides one-stop service for various cargoes featuring specialty chemicals, lithium batteries, full vehicles, refrigerated containers, and precision instruments; railroad intermodal transportation services; specialty chemicals road, sea-railway intermodal transportation services, and CRH express services; project logistics solution ex-factory to jobsite for turnkey EPC projects and heavy industries; transport and yard services for various types of tank containers; and ship asset management, ship management and supply, and liquid bulk shipping services. In addition, it offers liquid bulk cargo carriers for shipping services; road transportation of various chemicals and inbound and outbound services; and chemical distribution activities. Milkyway Intelligent Supply Chain Service GroupCo., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Shanghai, China.
